prompt:
Refine this exact Chinese ghost-shield guard with TWO clear changes: substantially LESS BODY EQUIPMENT for a clearer human silhouette, and a LARGER WHOLE SHIELD.

BODY EQUIPMENT REDUCTION — actually remove pieces, not just darken them:
Retain his strong adult male physique, same face/solid dark beard/hair, compact head/body ratio and standing orientation.
REMOVE the large exposed screen-right shoulder pauldron completely. Replace that area with a simple fitted navy cloth shoulder and short sleeve, showing a clear rounded shoulder/upper-arm silhouette; a modest area of natural warm forearm may show between sleeve and ONE plain short wrist bracer. No huge plated glove; free hand is a naturally relaxed fist with a simple dark fingerless glove or bare hand.
REMOVE the rigid faceted chest plate. Use a simple dark navy Chinese CROSS-COLLAR heavy-cloth tunic with one clean muted blue-gray lapel and a broad plain waist sash. Strong chest volume from cloth shape, not many plates.
REMOVE most layered hip/skirt armor. Keep only ONE short asymmetric front cloth tab and ONE short rear tab over simple dark loose/tapered trousers. Hem ends around upper thigh so both legs and their gap read clearly. No thigh armor sheets or long overlapping coat tails swallowing the knees.
REMOVE decorative kneecaps/shin guards and bright boot borders. Use sturdy simple navy boots with only one plain cuff/fold and two large shaded masses.
Preserve a little pale ghost-mane collar and existing restrained cyan curls as a small shoulder/neck accent, but it must not become a huge bright bib. Don't add accessories, belts, jewelry or new patterns.
The result remains a STRONG sturdy shield bearer, not slender or weak. Clear broad shoulder -> narrowed waist -> two distinct planted legs, with visible negative space between free arm and torso. Quiet navy clothing is subordinate to the shield.

WHOLE SHIELD ENLARGEMENT:
Increase the COMPLETE integrated ghost-mask shield by about 15–20 percent relative to the human figure, BOTH width and height, not only its bottom panel. Preserve its exact chosen design: upper blue guardian face, cyan eyes, short silver forehead horn, broad oblique cobalt body, upper silver jaw band, sculptural lower horn and silver side edges. Scale/reattach organically, no flattening, no perspective change, no new emblem or lost curved edge. Shield remains the dominant primary shape and protector. Extend mainly toward the open screen-left space, slightly lower, keeping its lowest tip above or near boot-sole height. Human face and both boots remain visible.
Carrying left arm is behind the shield with plausible support; no exposed duplicate fist on shield. Free screen-right arm stays clear and unarmed. No sword, polearm or extra shield.

PAINT:
Same coherent cobalt shield / navy garment / steel trim / cyan accent palette, natural skin. Bold clean icon contours, very few LARGE matte color/value shapes, 2–3 per material, no noisy facets or texture. Figure itself must not be globally stretched/shrunk or redesigned in identity. Full character plus enlarged shield safely in square warm ivory canvas with margins, no crop, labels, scene or floor shadow.
purpose: Remove excess body armor to clarify torso/arm/leg silhouette and enlarge the complete integrated ghost shield.
visual_review: Chest/shoulder/skirt/leg armor reduced to quiet navy cloth and simple bracer/boots; arm and leg gaps clearer; entire ghost shield enlarged.
